gates.note: A commit-bound native Ubuntu Noble, ROS 2 Jazzy, and Gazebo Harmonic smoke artifact must be retained and validated.
A validated mutual-TLS benchmark bundle from two representative deployment hosts must pass the healthy-LAN target.
A supervised pilot with at least two physical robots and one simulated participant must produce a validated evidence bundle.
At least one independent manufacturer adapter must provide retained conformance results.
An independent security review must be completed with blocking findings resolved or explicitly accepted.
An independent safety review of the coordination boundary and pilot controls must be completed.
An independent interoperability review must validate the public protocol and adapter contracts.
A tagged, checksummed, provenance-attested release artifact must be retained and install-tested.
